rows.screening_result: 3 trials via llama.cpp server (127.0.0.1:8090, OpenAI-compatible, exercised through the real src.llm_core.llm_call path): 13/14, 12/14, 12/14 = 37/42 (88.1%). doc_image-01 (vision) PASSED all 3 trials -- this is the first LM1/LM2 evidence of Gemma 4 actually resolving the vision task correctly and repeatably. Beats LM1's Ollama-library gemma4:12b result (11/13, 84.6%, unproven artifact mapping) on both pass rate and provenance certainty. avg wall_time 14.2s/call, max 39.1s -- fully GPU-resident (9.55GB/10GB), faster than gpt-oss:20b local-strong incumbent (15.2s).
rows.promotion: EVIDENCE-BACKED PROMOTION for vision, BLOCKED FROM BINDING: same production Ollama version wall as the rest of this pass -- this evidence came from a scratch llama.cpp server (127.0.0.1:8090), not production execute_local (which only calls Ollama on 127.0.0.1:11434). Two independent paths (Ollama-library via LM1's second instance, and official-QAT-GGUF-direct via llama.cpp this pass) now agree Gemma 4 12B is a strong vision candidate. capabilities.vision stays null until the operator upgrades production Ollama and gemma4:12b is pulled directly onto 127.0.0.1:11434 -- see 'Exact safe action' in the LM2 evidence doc.
